class_description: Georgia HO3 — eligible vs ineligible risks
small_business_appetite: ELIGIBLE (not all-inclusive): single-family principal residence; townhouse/duplex if single-building; seasonal/secondary owner-occupied only (NO rental); working electrical/HVAC/plumbing; roofs acceptable or Roof Damage Exclusion; slab/crawl ≤3ft/pilings/piers/stilts; trusts OK. INELIGIBLE: vacant/for-sale unoccupied >30 days/under construction; >5 acres (unless planned community ≤10 acres); foreclosure >90 days past due or disrepair; space heaters/wood stoves as primary heat; fuses/knob&tube/aluminum/Federal Pacific panels; attic water heaters (tankless OK); asbestos; farm animals/farming; bite-history/aggressive animals; home daycare/college housing/nursing; historic district homes; mobile/log/manufactured/trailer (modular wood OK); any rental; unconventional construction; open foundation not enclosed; damaged exterior; landslide/mudslide/brushfire/hillside >30°/over water; PC 10.

class_description: Georgia HO3 — discounts, deductibles, optional coverages
small_business_appetite: Discounts: Home Buyer (NB within 12 months; renewals yrs 1–3); Loss Free (3 yrs losses <$500); Affinity Military/First Responder; Golden Age 60+; Protective Device / secured community; Wind Loss Prevention / storm shutters; Tankless Water Heater; Tree Free Yard; E-Policy. All-peril deductibles $1k–$50k. Payment: Annual, Semiannual, Quarterly, Ten Pay. Optionals include increased jewelry/silverware special limits, special computer coverage, ordinance/law buy-up, water backup/sump $5k/$10k/$25k, loss assessment buy-up, personal injury, equipment breakdown $25k/$50k agg, identity theft $25k, 25% increased Coverage A RC, roof damage exclusion, pool/hot tub liability buy-back (4ft fence, no slide/diving board), personal property RC.

PEX (pre-2006), polybutylene, galvanized plumbing and/or any claim in last 3 years → water damage coverage limited to $10,000. Golf carts excluded. Animal liability limited. Trampolines excluded. Pool/hot tub liability excluded (buy-back available). Outdated roofs settle ACV: metal ≥26 yrs, slate/tile ≥21, composition/other ≥16 (calendar year). Solar/renewable energy systems excluded. Limited fungi/microbes/rot $5,000 included. Binding: meet eligibility/UW guidelines; 100% insured to value; quote/bind up to 60 days ahead; hurricane/tropical storm restrictions; signed app & docs retained for audit.
